verdict.rationale: As an AI skill pack for coding agents, gstack produces AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own project data. /review analyzes the diff for SQL safety and trust-boundary issues, the design review rates each dimension 0-10 and explains what a 10 looks like, /cso finds exploitable defects, QA produces health scores and a ship-readiness summary, and office-hours challenges premises and generates alternatives. One community user reports it drafts suggested replies and improved their code quality. Missing for 10: insights over non-code data such as usage, business or analytics data; in-depth documentation of how insights are derived beyond short skill descriptions; broader independent hands-on corroboration.
